The core synthesis mechanism, Jarvis, aggregates structured inputs into a launch readiness assessment. This assessment is composed of categorical health indicators, a phase matrix, and actionable recommendations. The system enforces a bootstrap-to-canonical transition, isolating synthetic picks from public metrics. The accountability ledger ensures traceability of all picks, distinguishing between bootstrap and canonical states. Failure modes arise from missing external configuration or incomplete data, triggering UNKNOWN or NOT_READY states. The design supports retroactive analysis through snapshots and historical tracking, enabling robust validation and risk mitigation.
